0022600223.text: The Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East, 2-8 over their last ten) visit the Pelicans (4-6, 3-3 at home, 11th in the West, 4-6 over their last ten) for their 11th game of the season, and both teams are on two-game losing streaks. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise), while Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a game-time decision for rest; he averages 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (out, ankle), Trey Murphy III (out, knee tendinitis) and Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and the teams have yet to meet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Nets' most recent meeting a 116-113 loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
